paper_title: VideoLLaMB Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory   Bridges
caption: GPU Memory Cost. We apply all the experiments on a single NVIDIA A800 GPU.
model_annotation:
Here's a description of the line plot, following the guidelines you provided:

The plot illustrates the GPU memory cost as a function of the number of frames. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Frames" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, with tick labels displayed every 200 frames. The y-axis is labeled "Memory (GB)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick labels displayed every 50 GB. A red, dashed line with circle markers represents "VideoLLaMB," starting at approximately 25 GB when the number of frames is 0 and increasing to approximately 85 GB when the number of frames is 1000. A pink, dashed line with circle markers represents "VideoLLaMB-R," starting at approximately 30 GB at 0 frames and rising to approximately 90 GB at 1000 frames.  A blue, solid line with triangle markers represents "LLaVA," beginning at about 35 GB at 0 frames and increasing to around 155 GB at 1000 frames. A light blue, solid line with triangle markers represents "LLaVA-NeXT," starting at approximately 40 GB and reaching approximately 160 GB at 1000 frames. A purple, solid line with triangle markers represents "VideoLLaVA," which begins at approximately 50 GB when the number of frames is 0 and increasing to approximately 145 GB when the number of frames is 1000.
